stories.title: Leafs rally to beat Islanders, snap 9-game skid
stories.summary: The Toronto Maple Leafs spotted the New York Islanders a 2-0 lead on Monday and it appeared as if the Canadian visitors were on their way to a 10th straight loss.

stories.title: Herro’s 32 powers Bucks past Raptors 116-111
stories.summary: Tyler Herro scored 32 points, including 15 in the third quarter, as the Milwaukee Bucks powered past the Toronto Raptors 116-111 on Monday to snap a 13-game losing skid.

stories.title: Minister defends not initially banning college with surging OSAP usage
stories.summary: Universities Minister Nolan Quinn this spring made six career colleges ineligible for OSAP due to what the ministry called concerns with "high-risk" admissions practices.

stories.title: ‘Resistance’ group hosting Toronto conference added to Canada’s terrorist list
stories.summary: Masar Badil had been planning to host its North American conference in Toronto later this month.

stories.title: Premiers Ford, Smith say interprovincial trade remains complicated despite efforts
stories.summary: Ford says Ontario is the only province that eradicated every trade exemption, but he agrees that internal free trade has been challenging to implement.

stories.title: Steven Del Duca fires top civil servant using ‘strong chair’ powers
stories.summary: One source in the region, granted confidentiality to speak freely, said staff felt “blindsided” and that the decision feels “ruthless and mean.”

stories.title: Premier Ford won’t agree to trade deal without auto, steel and manufacturing approval
stories.summary: Ottawa is seeking what it says is an “interim deal” that would provide tariff relief for Canadian businesses and resolve core trade irritants.

stories.title: Former firefighter responsible for Ontario teen’s death in 1968, police say
stories.summary: Jacqueline Dunleavy, 16, died on Jan. 9, 1968. The Grade 10 student at Westminster Secondary School was working at the Stanley Variety Store that evening.

stories.title: Navdeep Bains vows united front at Queen’s Park after narrow Liberal leadership win
stories.summary: Bains has a long road ahead of him if he wants to challenge the Ford government in the next election, which could be as far away as 2030.

stories.title: Leafs blow another lead as winless run continues
stories.summary: Jim Hiller was behind the bench with his Maple Leafs desperately hanging onto a one-goal lead.
